findings.description: TLS certificate verification is disabled via InsecureSkipVerify=true, enabling MITM attacks on download/update traffic.
findings.remediation: Set InsecureSkipVerify to false by default. If needed for debugging, gate it behind an explicit insecure flag and warning.
findings.verification: Attempt connection to a host with invalid cert; request must fail unless explicit insecure mode is enabled.

findings.description: Dependency scan reports 14 reachable vulnerabilities affecting Go stdlib and x/image/x/net usage in active code paths.
findings.remediation: Upgrade toolchain to a patched Go release (>=1.25.11) and bump vulnerable modules (e.g., golang.org/x/image, golang.org/x/net) to fixed versions.
findings.verification: Re-run govulncheck and confirm zero reachable vulnerabilities.
evidence: govulncheck reports GO-2026-5039, GO-2026-5037, GO-2026-4918, GO-2026-4870 and others reachable
Scan summary: code affected by 14 vulnerabilities from stdlib and golang.org/x/image

findings.description: User-supplied URLs are fetched directly without host/IP allowlist or scheme restriction, enabling access to internal network targets if run in sensitive environments.

attackVector.sink: Outbound HTTP requests to arbitrary destinations

findings.remediation: Validate URL scheme (http/https only), block localhost/private CIDR by default, and optionally support an explicit allowlist mode.
findings.verification: Attempt download from localhost/169.254.169.254/private CIDR; tool should deny unless explicitly permitted.
evidence: cmd/gdown/main.go:83 takes args[0] URL and passes to engine config without policy checks
internal/gui/add_dialog.go:40 accepts any non-empty URL string
pkg/engine/chunk.go:81 and pkg/engine/engine.go:158 create requests directly from provided URL

findings.description: Checksum verification is optional and off by default, allowing silent acceptance of tampered payloads when users do not provide checksum input.

attackVector.sink: File persisted and marked completed without integrity assertion

findings.remediation: Support mandatory checksum mode for sensitive use and optionally auto-fetch signed checksums for known sources.
findings.verification: Run with strict checksum mode and confirm mismatched payloads fail before completion.
evidence: pkg/engine/engine.go:141-149 only verifies checksum when cfg.Checksum is non-empty

findings.description: Manual proxy URL is parsed but not constrained by scheme/host policy, increasing risk of accidental insecure proxy routing or interception.
findings.remediation: Validate proxy URL scheme to http/https/socks5, reject credential-bearing URLs in UI, and surface warnings for plaintext proxies.
findings.verification: Set invalid or unsupported proxy scheme and confirm configuration is rejected.
evidence: pkg/util/http.go:34 uses url.Parse(proxyURL) and applies directly to ProxyURL when parse succeeds
internal/gui/settings.go stores proxy URL as free-form text

findings.description: Security-relevant events (invalid TLS certs, blocked targets, proxy misuse attempts) are not explicitly audit-logged.
findings.remediation: Add structured security event logging for TLS errors, URL policy denials, and proxy configuration failures.
findings.verification: Trigger each event type and confirm structured log entries with timestamp and reason.
evidence: No dedicated security logging module or security-event tags found in current code graph

gaps: No policy layer for destination URL restrictions

rateLimiting.recommendation: Apply destination policy/rate guard if app is used in automated pipelines.

logging.recommendation: Add structured security event logs and denial reasons.

limitations: No endpoint/auth middleware graph nodes (desktop/CLI architecture), so trust-boundary model adapted to input vectors
